IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Van De Wege, Fitzgibbon, Holy, Hayes, Reykdal, Bergquist, and Freeman; by request of LEOFF Plan 2 Retirement Board

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an optional life annuity benefit for plan 2 members of the law enforcement officers' and firefighters' retirement system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an optional life annuity benefit for plan 2members of the law enforcement officers' and firefighters' retirementsystem; and adding a new section to chapter 41.26 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.26 RCWunder the subchapter heading "plan 2" to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At the time of retirement, plan 2 members may purchase anoptional actuarially equivalent life annuity benefit from the lawenforcement officers' and firefighters' retirement system plan 2retirement fund established in RCW 41.50.075. A minimum payment oftwentyfive thousand dollars is required. (2) Subject to rules adopted by the department, a member purchasingan annuity under this section must pay all of the cost with an eligiblerollover, direct rollover, or trusteetotrustee transfer from aneligible retirement plan. (a) The department shall adopt rules to ensure that all eligiblerollovers and transfers comply with the requirements of the internalrevenue code and regulations adopted by the internal revenue service.The rules adopted by the department may condition the acceptance of a p. 1 HB 2577rollover or transfer from another plan on the receipt of informationnecessary to enable the department to determine the eligibility of anytransferred funds for taxfree rollover treatment or other treatmentunder federal income tax law. (b) "Eligible retirement plan" means a tax qualified plan offeredby a governmental employer.
